create_balance_env: create a cartpole balance environment with smooth rewards and a default 10 second time limit
create_balance_sparse_env: create a cartpole balance environment with sparse rewards for benchmarking pole balancing tasks
create_swingup_env: create a cartpole swing-up environment starting the pole upside down with smooth rewards
create_multi_pole_env: create a cartpole environment with two or three poles chained together for harder control
run_make_model: run the model generator to produce an MJCF XML string for a cart with N poles
